notes.title: House of Caravan released for Mac!
notes.notes:
Heya! 

We're very happy to announce that House of Caravan has been released for Mac on Steam. 

We are aware that there have been many Mac users waiting for the game, so we are glad that finally the game is coming to Mac!

Oculus ready version is coming soon for both PC Windows and Mac!

notes.title: House of Caravan patch v.1.0.1
notes.notes:
Heya!

We're here to bring you the first patch notes.

It's been almost three weeks since the release of the game and we hope all of you have been enjoying it. It has been very interesting to develop House of Caravan alongside with the feedback of the players.

We have received some suggestions to add new features to the game, and we are taking notes of each one, but please keep in mind that we are a very small team so we can be a bit slow in our work and also in assisting to any user having issues while playing it. We apologise for that!

Currently we are focusing mainly in the Mac version of the game and also in the Oculus Rift support for PC Windows, and we're super excited about it!

We're looking forward to bring you the new exciting features in the next weeks!

[u]Version 1.0.1 Patch Notes[/u] 
 [list]
    [*]Added AntiAliasing option
    [*]Added Mouse Invert option
    [*]Added V-Sync option
    [*]Edited some letters to clarify meaning 
    [*]Edited some puzzles to clarify meaning 
    [*]Fixed some dynamic shadows effects
    [*]Fixed some fragmented objects to ignore collision with player
    [*]Flashlight battery now lasts a bit longer
    [*]Small changes to inventory layout 
    [*]Small changes to menu layout 
[/list]
